entries.description: List of chrootuid service entries. Each entry defines a restricted execution environment with a command to run under a specific user and chroot directory. Entries must be ordered; the first applicable entry is used by service managers when invoking chrootuid-based daemons. Each item is a flat object with named fields. Required per-entry fields: newroot (string), newuser (string), command (list of strings). Optional per-entry field: interactive (bool). No additional fields allowed beyond those specified below in items. The 'name' field is only for comment/documentation purposes and is not passed to chrootuid(1).
